scope: Fresh independent final-controller review input; excludes any previous review verdict

contract.writer: Lower-tier coding worker; root remains sole production-state writer. Reviewer does not implement.
preserve: campaign identity and original science acceptances
historical one-use repair validators and numerical contracts
followup_constraints: Only already recorded same-task implementation author; requested and transport-selected route remain identical.

Failed-initial branch needs the latest actual acknowledged same-author execute/repair packet with a recorded blocker, issue.class code or numeric, substantive true, exact packet/input/agent and matching stored raw receipt seal. Neither source nor current task/packet nor prior successful history may supply a candidate. No refused/unacknowledged, environment-only, foreign-input/author or acknowledged UNKNOWN outcome qualifies.
No prior successful candidate may be substituted by the failed-initial branch. Retain current candidate-success checks for successful-base followup.
Accepted dispatch evidence remains required. Subsequent result binds the acknowledged failed base and new actual receipt. Success supplies a real new candidate; independent review still required.
ACK failure is atomic; duplicate ACK/record may not consume a second attempt or allowance. No counters/history/limits are reset.
tests: New tiny direct save and CLI mutation tests using a two-hop symlink; verify both aliases, pinned target, sidecar location, subsequent CLI read and ordinary non-symlink init.
New ordinary refusal tests: explicit no-retry and exhausted refusal remain held without mutation; temporary refusal still resumes with exact identities.

New generic structured-plan and failed-initial-author followup tests through ACK, result and fresh independent review; wrong plan/base receipt/input/agent/route, unresolved outcome and duplicate transitions reject atomically.

Seed accounting, historical history, used and pending ultra in the copied fixture; all remain unchanged except the intended new transition. Reuse existing targeted successful-base and typed-obligation controls.

Use current local .venv, -B, no pytest cache, owned disposable temp paths. No scientific producers, old campaign replay, CF4/SavedLaw/Gaia historical validation sweep, native dispatch or production state mutation.
contract.publication_condition: Fresh independent read-only review of the final two-file diff and raw targeted outcomes; publish only the reviewed code identity under owner authority. No original scientific promotion.
contract.plan_compatibility: Preserve existing string and dictionary plan bytes/meaning and digest. Validate meaningful nonempty string or nonempty object consistently; no retrospective normalization and no fabricated base candidate. Existing frozen special-repair validators retain their own exact contracts.

requirements_and_counterexamples.finding: Atomic save replaces the caller-supplied final symlink instead of the durable target. The live ACTIVE_CONTROLLER path is exactly such a two-hop alias. CLI mutation forks state into the repo filesystem while external LIVE_STATE remains stale.
requirements_and_counterexamples.counterexample: save(alias -> target generation1, generation2) leaves target generation1 and replaces alias with ordinary generation2 file.
requirements_and_counterexamples.required_repair: Resolve and pin the durable target before read/write, create/replace temporary state adjacent to that target, preserve both symlink hops, and keep CLI result sidecars beside the pinned state. Preserve normal new-file init.

requirements_and_counterexamples.finding: Ordinary launch_failed ignores explicit retry_prohibited although the same API honors it for discovery; ordinary prelaunch resume then authorizes an exhausted refused packet.
requirements_and_counterexamples.counterexample: launch_failed(..., reason="exhausted monthly quota", retry_prohibited=True); resume(kind=prelaunch_transport, exact packet/input) succeeds.
requirements_and_counterexamples.required_repair: Persist ordinary retry prohibition and refuse restoration of the same prohibited/exhausted route before changing phase, reservation, evidence or attempts. Retain the successful temporary non-prohibited restore path. Do not rewrite historical receipts.

requirements_and_counterexamples.finding: Research record accepts structured plans that same-author followup rejects; even a string plan cannot resume an initial controls-failed author because no successful base candidate exists. Fresh same-profile context remains possible, so this is a continuation defect rather than universal deadlock.
requirements_and_counterexamples.counterexample: execute blocker -> research success with dict plan -> repair ACK to first author rejects type; string plan still rejects nonexistent successful base. Fresh author ACK succeeds for both.
requirements_and_counterexamples.required_repair: Use one exact nonempty string/object plan representation check for generic research record and followup. Add a narrow dispatched followup branch binding the recorded initial implementation blocker and its sealed raw receipt, with absent/null candidate rather than a fabricated success candidate. Keep the existing successful-base branch and all identity/route/independence/unknown-outcome guards.

actual_consumers: R27-CF4-UNIFORM-SUPPORT-CALIBRATION-QUOTIENT andR28-CF4-EXACT-CALIBRATION-FACTOR-ACTUAL-CONSUMER completed actualscientificoutput+independentreviews, no acceptancepromotion; reuse unchanged numericalresults, no reruns.
